Relates an [`Expression`](../classes/gmeow-Expression.md) to a [`Manifestation`](../classes/gmeow-Manifestation.md) that embodies it. Non-functional: an [`Expression`](../classes/gmeow-Expression.md) may be embodied in many Manifestations (hardcover, paperback, EPUB). Inverse of [`gmeow:embodies`](gmeow-embodies.md).
